test_title: PYST 12: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All p are r.

Some r are c.

All c are d.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some d are p.

II. Some c are p.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9ff235f1f8a5534562a38963a7b96c57ef823d704fea0f13cbe3a315a7c2e0.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some d are p → Does not follow (As all p are r, some r are c and all c are d. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some c are p → Does not follow (As all p are r and some r are c. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
